title: Virgo in a situationship
caption: virgo in a situationship: low maintenance on purpose, reading every text for what it really means
cta: comment MUTUAL and i'll send it to you ✦ free from the align app

lines: Virgo, you've made yourself *easy to keep.*
No demands. No questions. Always helpful.
So it never feels like *too much.*
Ruled by *Mercury,* you read every text twice,
But you shouldn't need to decode
I deserve to be *wanted,* not just useful.
My needs are not a burden.
The right person shows up *on purpose.*

opts.sub: FOR THE ONE WHO KEEPS TRYING

scenes.pill: YOUR AFFIRMATION IS ON ITS WAY
lines: and I'll send you the affirmation for it,
